data.narrative:
Raphe mPhibr is a Series B defense and security company founded by Vivek and Vikash Mishra that has raised $145M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 companies (2 public, 8 private) operating in the same sector and stage, including five primary private peers: Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Defense Unicorns ($1.0B), and Heven AeroTech ($1.0B).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression, using total raised as a proxy base of $145M and applying a typical Series B-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.9x, yields $276M. Peer-median analysis across the six same-sector, same-stage comparables produces a median valuation of $1.1B, with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. These two methods triangulate to a low of $234M, median of $700M, and high of $1.3B.

The wide spread between stage-progression and peer-median reflects meaningful uncertainty around positioning relative to the reference set. The peer cohort exhibits substantial variance—a 10x spread between floor and ceiling—suggesting material heterogeneity in company quality, capital deployment, or revenue scale within the defense tech Series B segment. A post-money valuation in the $500M–$900M range would sit below peer median but above early-stage stepped multiples, warranting verification of revenue, customer concentration, and product differentiation relative to the named comparables.
